newsitem.title: USA: Widening WTI/Brent spread hampers La. sweet crudes.
newsitem.headline: Widening WTI/Brent spread hampers La. sweet crudes.

text.p: Widening spreads between U.S. West Texas Intermediate/Cushing and North Sea Brent have worked to move Louisiana sweet crudes off highs set earlier in the session, crude traders said Wednesday.
"As soon as the spread moved out, we saw the LLS (Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James) come down," said a crude trader.
LLS had firmed to sell at a 36 cents premium to the March WTI/Cushing, but now was talked at only a 25-30 cts edge, trading last at 30 cts, traders said.
LLS prices remained a shade firmer than late Tuesday.
March WTI/Cushing was 20 cts firmer at $22.65-75.
